# JetBrains Marketplace — Store Description

> Paste the HTML below into the JetBrains Marketplace plugin description field.

---

```html
<h2>Real-Time API Contract Testing in Your IDE</h2>

<p>
  Kei validates your API calls against OpenAPI and GraphQL contracts as you type.
  Breaking changes show up as inline warnings — not as production incidents.
  Works with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.
</p>

<h3>Contract Discovery</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Automatic detection of OpenAPI (v2/v3) and GraphQL schemas</li>
  <li>Supports local files, remote URLs, and schema registries</li>
  <li>Contract Explorer panel with a tree view of all endpoints and types</li>
</ul>

<h3>Real-Time Validation</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Validates every API call against its contract in under 50ms</li>
  <li>Inline red underlines for contract violations — just like compiler errors</li>
  <li>Breaking change detection with severity levels (critical, warning, info)</li>
  <li>Side-by-side contract diff viewer for comparing schema versions</li>
</ul>

<h3>Quick Fixes and Refactoring</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Press Alt+Enter on any violation for smart fix suggestions</li>
  <li>Auto-rename fields, update types, and add missing parameters</li>
  <li>One-click mock server generation from any contract</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Analytics dashboard — track contract health and violation trends</li>
  <li>Version management — pin, compare, and roll back contract versions</li>
  <li>Advanced mocking — custom rules, delays, and error simulation</li>
  <li>Test generation — auto-generate contract tests from schemas</li>
</ul>

<h3>Team / Enterprise Features</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Security analyzer for API contract patterns</li>
  <li>AI-powered contract suggestions and improvements</li>
  <li>Team collaboration with shared registries and review workflows</li>
  <li>CI/CD integration for pipeline-level contract validation</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<table>
  <tr>
    <th>Free</th>
    <th>Pro</th>
    <th>Team / Enterprise</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>
      Contract discovery, real-time validation, inline warnings,
      quick fixes, contract explorer, breaking change detection,
      mock server
    </td>
    <td>
      Everything in Free plus analytics dashboard, version management,

    </td>
    <td>
      Everything in Pro plus security analyzer, AI features,

    </td>
  </tr>
</table>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>JDK 17 or later</li>

</ul>
```
